hypotheses.text: If Leo Marchetti had carried the ball forward, the chance of scoring would have been higher than the 12.5% achieved by shooting (carrying would create a better opportunity).
If Leo Marchetti had passed to Jonah Pike (LM), the probability of a goal would have been higher than 12.5% (the pass to the left would have produced a clearer chance).
If Leo Marchetti had passed to Emil Strand (CM), the probability of scoring would have exceeded 12.5% (playing to the central midfielder would have led to a better-quality opportunity).
